responses.first_body: Do not confuse a game with a blank promise. Say exactly what a win ends and what a loss leaves in place. If the existing support ceiling remains the limit, I will hear the rules. One victory of mine ends this repeated demand; put that in the terms before we begin.
responses.choice: Conditional willingness to hear/accept a bounded contest, not an asserted completed agreement or victory.
responses.accessible_reason: Perceived downside remains an already accepted position, with a gain available.

responses.first_body: No. Calling me afraid does not make that extra commitment acceptable. The existing support arrangement stands, but I will not put a greater military exposure on this wager. If you want entertainment, propose something that does not carry that consequence.
responses.choice: Refuse the additional stake and invite a differently bounded offer.
responses.accessible_reason: He explicitly judges the new exposure unacceptable; taunt does not automatically override this limit.

responses.first_body: State your name and whose business you bring. A private audience is one request; my agreement to your trade proposal is another. Let the letter be checked, then explain what you want before I promise anything.
responses.choice: Seek ordinary identity/purpose checks without claiming hidden knowledge or accepting the proposal.
responses.accessible_reason: Letter and request are known; reliability and terms remain unresolved.
